name: Brand Studio UI docs
positioning: The public reference for @brand-studio/ui: every component live, in any brand, with code you can copy.
audience: React developers and coding agents deciding which component fits a job and looking for working usage code.
voice: Exact: name the prop, the element and the behaviour
Plain: short sentences, no marketing adjectives
Honest: fictional demo brands are labelled as fictional

direction.tier: Reference docs: reading speed first. The chrome stays greyscale so the only colour on screen comes from the demo brand.
devices: Hero: one card rendered in all three demo brands, fanned; the picked brand comes to the front
One brand switch re-skins every live demo on the site at once
Top bar: offset-cards mark with version pill, centred search with a shortcut hint, framed icon buttons
Showcase cards sit on an even grid so every row ends on one line
invariants: Greyscale chrome: colour appears only inside demos
Geist for text, Geist Mono for code
Every component page: preview, installation, usage, examples, accessibility, API reference

imagery.subject: Live component demos; the only photography is the Still coffee set reused from the showcase
imagery.materials: Flat white and near-black surfaces with hairline borders
imagery.lighting: Flat; no shadows on the chrome
imagery.palette: Greyscale chrome; demo brands supply all colour
invariants: Demos render the real package, never screenshots
All demo brands share the Still coffee images
avoid: Invented adoption numbers, logos or testimonials
Mock screenshots in place of live components

motion.character: Quiet: the brand and mode switch crossfade; components carry their own motion.
motion.reducedMotion: No transitions; every state and all content stay reachable.

chapters.question: What is in the package?
chapters.visual: Hero, then an even grid of live demos.

chapters.question: How do I use this component?
chapters.message: See it live, then copy the code.
chapters.visual: Preview with collapsible code, then install, usage, examples and props.
chapters.mobileFallback: Preview at full width above the code.
